title: Require bounded coordinator dispatch attempts and first-write receipts
owner: Codex delegated mechanism author; parent owns independent review and rollout

ask.request: Repair watchdog failure to dispatch implementation using a bounded ready queue, persistent attempts and actual session/first-write receipts. New mechanism repair, not parked retry/resource restart.

bug_shape: Read-only coordinator-plan can recommend implementation without reserving an attempt or proving a worker wrote code; repeated checks can therefore replace execution.

scope.documentation_only: Dated supersession links in existing coordinator/runbook/legacy copies; exact missing audit original and manifest recovery.
scope.excluded: No gameplay edits, foreign board/registry/legacy queue/inspector edits, resource sampling, parked-task resurrection, automatic launch, acceptance weakening, Actions/deployment/paid services/credentials/merges/deletion/contact.

completion_criteria.criterion: Exact stop/source reconciliation precedes bounded Lower City selection.
completion_criteria.verification: Real scoped/evidence-guard offline tests for stops, denials, owners, reservations, frozen projects, unknown history and queue limits.

completion_criteria.criterion: Attempts and session/first-write receipts persist without false implementation or duplicate launch.
completion_criteria.verification: Hash-verified changed Git artifact test, launch-only state test, timeout/unknown liveness/rotation tests and independent-process CAS race.

completion_criteria.criterion: One initial plus one evidence-based correction cap retains historical attempts.
completion_criteria.verification: Persist/reload and exhausted/unknown-history tests; original source receipts and nulls retained, no reset command.

completion_criteria.criterion: Empty queue emits precise candidate escalation and current prompts target actual code.
completion_criteria.verification: Execute CLI on honestly empty checked-in queue; inspect exact candidate blockers and policy/prompt links; preserve legacy safety.

completion_criteria.criterion: No existing safety/acceptance regression or unauthorized rollout.
completion_criteria.verification: Run existing deterministic offline suites; inspect diff and triggers, open draft PR. Independent parent review and one-game-task rollout remain pending.

recommended_setup.provider_preference: Existing delegated Game-development executor; no new provider or service
recommended_setup.requested_model_and_effort: Inherited selected execution; runtime model/effort not independently attested
recommended_setup.environment_and_tools: Game-development /workspace/.setup/activate.sh; Python standard library, Git and read-only GitHub observations
recommended_setup.availability_checked: 2026-10-11: actual shell, Python, local locking/fsync and GitHub reads succeeded
recommended_setup.fallback: bounded_attempt_then_escalate; no alternate provider or lower-tier production substitute
recommended_setup.attempt_budget: One coherent implementation and one evidence-based correction; no further loop. Parent reserves independent review before adoption.
recommended_setup.verification_budget: Focused offline suite, retained regression suites, source/trigger inspection; parent independent acceptance and first one-game-task rollout
recommended_setup.escalation_criteria: Failed safety gate, unknown owner/stop, third attempt or missing authoritative backend; retain evidence and report
recommended_setup.requested_versus_confirmed: Selected runtime available; provider/model identity unconfirmed
recommended_setup.actual_outcome: Implementation and corrected local tests produced; independent review pending
